newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan o/n rates drop sharply to 4.50-5.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan o/n rates drop sharply to 4.50-5.50 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar fell to 4.50-5.50 percent on Thursday from 6.50-7.50 percent Wednesday in a market awash with funds, dealers said.
"Excess liquidity is available to everyone and its easy for borrowing banks to get funds because of the excess dinars circulating," one dealer said.
Dealers said the market has become more liquid since the start of weekly trade on Saturday. Rates have fallen significantly from last week.

Bankers said they did not expect a tighter market at start of weekly trade next Saturday, with maturing CDs and repurchase accords along with injection of funds into the banking system all indicating a relatively soft trend for the week.
